items.title: Flint-interactive: A language for creating interactive data visualizations
items.summary: Flint-interactive gives AI agents a language for creating interactive visualizations. Click a chart, filter data, highlight related content, and explore beyond the view the author originally chose.The post Flint-interactive: A language for creating interactive data visualizations appeared first on Microsoft Research.
